title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Site Reliability Engineering Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About the Team   SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.  Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.  Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.  What You Will Do   Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.   Lead cross-team initiatives:   Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.   Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.   Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.   Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.   Drive roadmap and execution:  Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.   Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).   Establish engineering excellence:   Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.   Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.   Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.   Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.   Champion security and compliance by design:   Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.   Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.   Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.   Partner with the Architects:  Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.   Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.   Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.   Own delivery outcomes:  Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.   Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.   Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.   Operate a healthy on-call:  High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).   Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.   Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.   Initiatives You Will Lead:   Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.   AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.   Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).   Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.   Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.   Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.   Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.   Success Metrics   Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.   Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.   Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.   Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.   Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.   SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).   What You Will Bring   Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.   Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.   Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.   Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.   Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.   Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.   Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).   Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.   What You’ll Need   Advanced skills in English   Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.   Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).   Database performance engineering and query optimization.   Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.   FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback). Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):  Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:  1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)  Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica  Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)  Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)  Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo  IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. title: Consultor(A) Comercial
description:
Empresa está contratando Consultor(A) Comercial em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.   Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.  Quem somos e o que fazemos   Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.  Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.  O que oferecemos   Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;  Modelo de trabalho híbrido;  Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;  Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;  Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;  Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;  Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.   Suas responsabilidades   Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:  Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ;  Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;  Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;  Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;  Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;  Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;  Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;  Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.    Quem procuramos   Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:  Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;  Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;  Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;  Habilidade paraconstruir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;  Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório. Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;  Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;  Graduação completa;  Inglês avançado.   Nosso compromisso com a diversidade   Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.  Faça parte da nossa história   Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineering Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Team    SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.    Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.   Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.    What You Will Do     Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.     Lead cross-team initiatives:     Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.     Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.     Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.     Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.     Drive roadmap and execution:    Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.     Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).     Establish engineering excellence:     Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.     Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.     Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.     Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.     Champion security and compliance by design:     Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.     Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.     Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.     Partner with the Architects:    Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.     Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.     Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.     Own delivery outcomes:    Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.     Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.     Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.     Operate a healthy on-call:    High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).     Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.     Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.     Initiatives You Will Lead:     Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.     AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.     Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor). Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real.    Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura):    Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por:   Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade.   Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade.   Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução.    Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:   1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)   Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna.   Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento.   Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real.  2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica    Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente.   Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico.  3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)   Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento.   Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais.   Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia.    Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)   Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes.   Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas.   Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres).   Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável.   Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias.   Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total.    Diferencial Competitivo    IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. Modelo:  100% Presencial ( Imprescindível residir em Campinas ou nas cidades próximas) Horário: Segunda a Quinta 07:30h as 17:30 e sexta 07:30h as 16:30h. Esse profissional terá papel essencial no desenvolvimento de projetos de produtos, elaboração de desenhos técnicos e suporte à engenharia e à produção. A posição possui forte atuação operacional e técnica, assumindo atividades de projeto e detalhamento, contribuindo para a evolução e eficiência dos processos de desenvolvimento. Requisitos essenciais   Experiência com CAD 3D para projetos mecânicos (preferencialmente PTC Creo ou similar) em nível intermediário a avançado; Experiência em projeto e detalhamento de peças e conjuntos mecânicos; Domínio em leitura e elaboração de desenho técnico mecânico; Experiência com estrutura de produto (lista de materiais / BOM); Experiência em interface técnica com engenharia e produção, especialmente em usinagem e injeção plástica; Conhecimento em GD&T (controle geométrico de tolerâncias); Experiência mínima de 5 anos em projetos mecânicos; Formação técnica, tecnólogo ou engenharia nas áreas mecânicas ou correlatas.   Diferenciais   Experiência em desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Conhecimento em análise de tolerâncias (stack-up); Experiência com documentação técnica e controle de projetos; Experiência revisando ou orientando tecnicamente outros desenhistas ou projetistas.   Perfil profissional   Senioridade técnica com atuação operacional; Perfil analítico e detalhista; Boa comunicação técnica com engenharia e produção; Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em projetos; Organização na gestão de documentação técnica.  Benefícios:  Vale Alimentação; Vale Refeição; Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível; Convênio médico coparticipativo para colaboradores (opcional); Convênio odontológico para colaboradores e dependentes (opcional); Parceria com a faculdade Esamc, desconto nas mensalidades de Graduações, Tecnólogos e MBA; Seguro de vida.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices. About the Role  As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains. This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth. What You’ll Do  Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.  What You’ll Bring  Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.  Nice to Have  Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish.  Why Regrow  Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits.   Acerca de Regrow  Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas. Sobre el Rol  Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos. Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR. Qué Harás  Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built. As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution. Your Role:  You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation. What You’ll Do:  Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026  What You Bring:  Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms Experience with international, enterprise environments Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions  Why Join the Remobi community:  Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued    Apply today:  If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities   Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.  Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.  Education and Experience  Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.  Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.  Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.). . Empresa está contratando Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations. Who We Are Looking For  We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities  Business Requirements & Client Engagement  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions. • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities. • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders. • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions. • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies. Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar). • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain. • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation. • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery. • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives. • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities. • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains. • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption. Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities. • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices. • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules). • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices. Must Have  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field. • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning). • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles. • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred). • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services. • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus). • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities. • Experience with project management and collaboration tools. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office. • Availability to travel. • Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer  • Competitive salary and benefits package. • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development. • A collaborative and international work environment. • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para AI Agent Manager (Media) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product  For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Job Purpose  The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes. The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization. Duties and Responsibilities  Main Responsibilities  Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks). Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows). Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems. Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic. Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users. Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases. Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements. Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability. Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.  Core Requirements  4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role. Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic. Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms). Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms). Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) Technical / AI-Related  Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts). Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus. Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Soft Skills  Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Domain Experience  Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.   Knowledge, Skills & Abilities  Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents. Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs. Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT. Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative. Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles. Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.  We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US  Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE  We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do  Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.  WHAT IT TAKES  The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.  Key Skills  Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.  Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. title: Gerente de segurança da informação
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gerente de segurança da informação em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

O Grupo Fleury  é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:  Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades:  Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.  Buscamos alguém que apresente:  Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)  Conhecimento específicos:  Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança  Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga:  Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:  • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times; • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas; • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo; • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas; • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade; • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!  Saúde e Bem-estar:  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família; • Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina; • Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras; • Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional; • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas; • Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade:  • Previdência privada; • Participação nos lucros; • Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia:  • Vale-Alimentação; • Vale-Refeição; • Vale-Transporte; • Auxílio-Creche; • Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação:  • Plataforma de ensino; • Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.  Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:  O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM) para provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade. Automação de alertas e incidentes com Logic Apps, Azure Functions e Webhooks. Conhecimento de containers, Kubernetes, Helm e Prometheus. Métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, MTTR, Change Failure Rate) e integração com pipelines DevOps. title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior  A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.    Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais  para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás  confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.   Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência . Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?   Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.  Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines; Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados; Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico; Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises; Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing; Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões; Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting; Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance; Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados; Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados; Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business. Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love. About YouYou're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications. You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically. You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects. You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations. You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.  About the RoleWrite full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team. Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.  Why Work at StayFi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate. You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

About NatureCo  NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.  Role and responsibilities  The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include:  Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management  Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.  Eligibility, due diligence & agreements  Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system  (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement  Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).  Stakeholder engagement and safeguards  Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.  Reporting  Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.  Teamwork and culture  Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.  Skills and attributes  To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.  Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.  Location  Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia  Submission instructions  Email CV and brief cover letter to  with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026
